title: ChurchCore Governance Dispatch Manifest
description: Central machine-readable registry of ratified Council decisions and cross-product implementation requirements.

decisions.title: Formal Ratification of ChurchCore Ecosystem Architecture & Commercial Portfolio Strategy

requirements.title: Constitutional Row-Level Security (RLS) Mandate
requirements.description: Enforce 100% PostgreSQL Row-Level Security on all tenant tables with zero service-role bypass in client components.
requirements.verification: All tables pass automated `audit:rls` or migration lint test suite.

requirements.title: Zero Cross-Application Data Propagation
requirements.description: No background event bus or automated synchronization daemon shall copy user records across sovereign application databases.
requirements.verification: Database schemas and API routes operate as independent sovereign silos.

decisions.title: Ratification of ChurchCore Ecosystem Branding Governance, Sub-Brand Taxonomy & White-Label Standards

requirements.title: Powered by ChurchCore Trust Badge
requirements.description: Display official 'Powered by ChurchCore' trust badge in application footers linking to security documentation (https://www.churchcore.io/security).
requirements.verification: Rendered in primary layouts (e.g. `src/components/layout/footer.tsx` or equivalent).

requirements.title: WCAG AAA Color Contrast Compliance
requirements.description: Audit and enforce minimum 7:1 contrast ratio across primary text, buttons, and card surfaces.
requirements.verification: Automated axe-core / Playwright accessibility scan passes with 0 contrast violations.

requirements.title: Sub-Brand Orthography & Nomenclature
requirements.description: Enforce standard naming orthography (ChurchCore, ChurchCore-LMS, ChurchCore-Academy, ChurchCoreCare, ChurchCore-Orthos, FaithFullScholars).
requirements.verification: Headers, titles, and metadata tags match exact capitalization rules.

decisions.title: Mandatory Cross-Repository Council Governance Synchronization Protocol across all ChurchCore Software

requirements.title: Mandatory Pre-Flight Agent Rule Installation
requirements.description: Install .agents/rules/council-governance-sync.md in product repo to mandate manifest pre-flight at session start.
requirements.verification: File exists and passes agent pre-flight checks.

requirements.title: Local Implementation Ledger Initialization
requirements.description: Initialize docs/council/ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md in product repo to log verified requirement implementations.
requirements.verification: File exists and contains acknowledgment entries with commit hashes and test surfaces.

decisions.title: Ecosystem Sovereign Control Plane, Automated Telemetry Protocol, and Central Directive Dispatch

requirements.title: Edge Telemetry Reporting File & Script
requirements.description: Maintain docs/control-plane/telemetry.json matching telemetry-schema.json and provide scripts/report-telemetry.py.
requirements.verification: Telemetry payload validates against schema and reports online/Vercel/Supabase status, MVP progress, and AI session history.

requirements.title: Mandatory Offline Readiness Assessment
requirements.description: Provide a comprehensive readiness score, blocking dependencies, and next actions if not live in production.
requirements.verification: Present in telemetry.json under online_status.readiness_assessment.

requirements.title: AI Session Logging & Deployment Diagnostics
requirements.description: Log LLM model used, session duration, deployment errors encountered, and exact mitigations applied.
requirements.verification: Fields populated in ai_session_telemetry and deployment_diagnostics upon session close.

decisions.title: Mandatory 100% MVP Feature-Completion Plan & Phased Verification Protocol Across All ChurchCore Product Packages

requirements.title: Maintain an Evidence-Backed MVP Completion Plan
requirements.description: Formulate and maintain docs/mvp-100-plan.md, or the product repository's existing canonical development plan, detailing any programmed features and improvements still required for MVP code completion. A generated plan must not replace a more authoritative, evidence-backed product plan.
requirements.verification: The edge repository's canonical plan identifies remaining technical scope, if any, with verification criteria and links to completed implementation evidence.

requirements.title: Phased Execution Gate: Human Trials Commence After MVP Code Completion
requirements.description: Automated unit, regression, authorization, security, and route tests accompany Phase 1 implementation. Comprehensive human trials, field-pilot sessions, and UAT commence after the product's evidence-backed MVP feature scope is technically complete.
requirements.verification: Phase 1 changes include proportionate automated verification; Phase 2 human-trial evidence begins only after the canonical product plan records MVP feature completion.

requirements.title: Vercel Production Deployment Technical Readiness
requirements.description: All build dependencies, Turbopack/Vite bundlers, environment variable schemas, and CSP headers must achieve clean deployable status.
requirements.verification: Clean npm run build export without build warnings or server-action errors.

requirements.title: Control Plane Telemetry Synchronization
requirements.description: Sync edge telemetry.json to reflect the product repository's evidence-backed feature-completion state and list subsequent Phase 2 human-trial or field-pilot workflows.
requirements.verification: docs/control-plane/telemetry.json agrees with the edge repository's canonical plan and distinguishes feature completion from pilot, deployment, and production readiness.

decisions.title: Sovereign Testing Council Protocol, 3-Phase Verification Lifecycle & Mandatory Inseparable Automated Testing Standard Across All ChurchCore Product Repositories

requirements.title: Universal Institutionalization of the Testing Council
requirements.description: Every product repository must institutionalize the Testing Council protocol within .agents/rules/churchcore-control-plane.md and track execution state in its repository-owned canonical roadmap. Central automation must not create a competing roadmap when the edge repository already designates one.
requirements.verification: Presence of the Testing Council rule, acknowledgment in docs/council/ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md, and evidence-backed state in the repository's canonical guide.

requirements.title: Inseparable Automated Testing Invariant
requirements.description: Automated unit, component, integration, and security regression tests must accompany all Phase 1 implementations. Automated tests may never be deferred to Phase 2.
requirements.verification: Automated test suite (npm test or python3 -m unittest) passes green on all Phase 1 PRs.

requirements.title: Sovereign Control Plane Split Priority & Gate Architecture
requirements.description: The Executive Mission Control dashboard shall maintain a split architecture: an in-progress priority queue on the left (ranking by backlog percentage) and a dedicated Phase 2 Testing Gate Spotlight on the right rail.
requirements.verification: Rendered in http://localhost:3333/ with green Phase 2 testing gate spotlight and live pilot status.

requirements.title: Closed-Loop Governance Challenge & Non-Stalling Automated Resolution
requirements.description: Edge repo governance challenges submitted via scripts/challenge-central-record.py may be automatically audited and reconciled in ChurchCore-Business without human stalling.
requirements.verification: Automation is limited to the central governance PR. Any edge repository change still requires that repository's owner approval, Council, Testing Council, pr-review, signature, CI, conversation-resolution, and protected-branch gates.

decisions.title: Executive Directive 2026-007-F: Ratification of the Fortified FaithFull Community Ecosystem & Multi-Persona Architecture

requirements.title: Multi-Persona Kingdom Community Expansion
requirements.description: Expand FaithFull Scholars beyond academic theologians to pastors, churches, evangelists, ministers, apologists, and councils while maintaining sovereign database isolation and high-performance Sunday SLA (<50ms).
requirements.verification: Multi-persona database migration with persona_type enum and organizations table deployed with verified RLS policies.

requirements.title: Faculty Profile Public Monograph Index & Peer-Reviewed Portfolio
requirements.description: Implement a public, searchable, filterable scholarly monograph index on scholar profiles featuring peer-reviewed articles, books, dissertations, citations, and DOI linkages.
requirements.verification: Public monograph index component rendering on /scholars/[slug] with client-side category filtering, keyword search, and passing unit tests.

requirements.title: Fortified Organization Ownership and SLA Guarantee
requirements.description: Cryptographically enforce organization owner validation at RLS insert, use SECURITY DEFINER helper public.is_organization_admin(org_id) for sub-50ms query execution, and prevent orphaned records with ON DELETE CASCADE.
requirements.verification: SQL migration verified against Supabase RLS security audit rules.

decisions.title: Executive Directive 2026-008: Universal Mandatory Post-Test Telemetry Synchronization Protocol

requirements.title: Universal Post-Test Telemetry Synchronization Mandate
requirements.description: On every successful PR push, merge, or commit to any repository in the ChurchCore ecosystem, after all automated testing is accepted, each repository must execute python3 scripts/report-telemetry.py --auto (or explicit flags) to sync verified status into docs/control-plane/telemetry.json.
requirements.verification: Presence of npm run telemetry:report in package.json, posttest hook, and online status verified in docs/control-plane/telemetry.json.

requirements.title: Autonomous Live Endpoint Probing & Blocker Clearance
requirements.description: report-telemetry.py shall automatically probe canonical production domains (HTTP 200/3xx), automatically set is_online: true, clear obsolete rehearsal blockers, and set readiness_score_pct to 100 upon live confirmation.
requirements.verification: Execution of python3 scripts/report-telemetry.py --auto returns exit code 0 and records ONLINE status.

decisions.title: Universal AI Gateway Consolidation on OpenRouter & Sustainable Model Evaluator Protocol

requirements.title: Universal OpenRouter Gateway Consolidation
requirements.description: All LLM calls across all software packages must be consolidated through OpenRouter as the unified, sovereign AI gateway (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions) with standardized OPENROUTER_API_KEY, HTTP-Referer, and X-Title headers. Direct raw proprietary vendor SDK bindings are prohibited in production runtimes.
requirements.verification: AI API integration codebases route exclusively to OpenRouter endpoint with verified privacy headers and data_collection: deny.

requirements.title: Sovereign Model Evaluator & Dynamic Tier Router
requirements.description: Every package must implement an AI Model Usage Evaluator that scores incoming prompt workloads and dynamically routes between Tier 1 (High Truthness/Reasoning: Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, DeepSeek R1), Tier 2 (High Efficiency/Balanced: Gemini 2.5 Flash, LLaMA 3.3 70B), and Tier 3 (Ultra-Low-Cost Fast Triage).
requirements.verification: Presence of model evaluator module and unit tests validating that low-complexity tasks resolve to Tier 2/3 and mission-critical theological/safeguarding checks resolve to Tier 1.

requirements.title: Cost & Sustainability Guardrails
requirements.description: Enforce per-request max_tokens caps, multi-model fallback cascades for 99.99% Sunday availability, token usage audit logging, and tenant circuit breakers to prevent runaway token spend.
requirements.verification: Unit tests verifying fallback cascades, token tracking instrumentation, and rate limits in AI gateway dispatchers.
